headline: Microsoft makes Windows settings backup default in 26H2 update
summary: Microsoft has made Windows settings backup and restore the default behavior in its 26H2 update, applying automatically to Microsoft Entra-joined and Entra hybrid-joined enterprise systems.

claims.statement: Microsoft made Windows settings backup and restore the default on Entra-joined enterprise systems in the 26H2 update.

sources.quote: Microsoft enables Windows settings backup by default for orgs
Windows settings backup and restore is now enabled by default on all Microsoft Entra-joined or Microsoft Entra hybrid-joined enterprise systems upgraded to Windows 11 26H2
Microsoft makes Windows settings backup the default in 26H2
